context.title: Does the attached context make a difference
context.caveat: This is not an experiment: Cockpit attaches context when there is some, so the two columns do not describe the same work — a branch with a ticket and a review is better framed than a bare branch. A clear gap is a signal; a small gap says nothing.
context.notComparable: Not comparable yet — it takes at least five handbacks on each side. So far: {{briefed}} with context, {{plain}} without.
